metadata.literal_pointer: PDF pages2-4, draft plat sheets1-3; NE and SE corner annotations, page4 legal courses and datum; pages1,5,6 provide project context.

survey_derivation.closure_method: Retain18 transcribed boundary vertices and close the sub-0.05-foot last-course residual directly to the first vertex; no adjustment of bearings or scaling.
survey_derivation.scale_factor_handling: No second scale factor applied: sheet1 says bearings and distances are based on Oklahoma North NAD83 grid, and coordinates are grid. Independently printed NE and SE grid coordinates agree with the summed two2640.78-foot section lengths without rescaling. The supplied grid-to-ground factor is recorded, not used to transform grid coordinates twice.
survey_derivation.north_half_distance_derivation: Sheet1 north650.01-foot segment plus1990.77-foot segment =2640.78 feet; this sum is not labelled as a single printed dimension.
survey_derivation.south_half_distance_derivation: Sheet2/3 legal course2290.78 feet plus300 feet and the50-foot road strip =2640.78 feet; independently derived, not an assumption of equal quarters.

transformation.operation: Inverse of SPCS83 Oklahoma North zone (US survey foot) + NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
transformation.pipeline: proj=pipeline step proj=unitconvert xy_in=us-ft xy_out=m step inv proj=lcc lat_0=35 lon_0=-98 lat_1=36.7666666666667 lat_2=35.5666666666667 x_0=600000 y_0=0 ellps=GRS80 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg
transformation.method: Transform reconstructed draft-survey ring fromEPSG6553 toWGS84 with always_xy and allow_ballpark=False; Shapely representative_point of transformed ring.
transformation.accuracy_caveat: Datum-operation accuracy and printed coordinate decimals are not a claim of campus locator positional accuracy. This is a derived interior locator from a draft plat, not a registered boundary or building position.

metadata.date_scope: February12,2026 is the explicit drawing preparation date. Staff-report cover says March4,2025 while body refers to February2026; both are retained as conflicting source text. The linked official agenda independently dates the meeting March4,2026. None is selected lifecycle.
metadata.ownership_scope: Draft plat itself names Clydesdale Tulsa Holdings LLC; report cover has older Bird Creek Ranch owner label. No corporate ownership role is normalized.
metadata.geometry_scope: One derived interior locator from the whole draft tract. It is not an official cadastral boundary, a data hall position or a construction footprint. Five planned lots and reserves remain one campus; source polygon remains local.
metadata.aerial_scope: Page6 is2023 imagery used solely as broad topology context. It creates no imagery review outcome.

semantics.precision_scope: One derived point inside the named Project Clydesdale draft survey tract. Official-source classification refers to public planning custody, not survey approval. No registered boundary, individual hall, construction footprint, road junction, offsite benchmark or mailing address is selected.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: The draft supplies no site-specific horizontal accuracy. Printed decimals, traverse closure, agreement between anchors and two-metre datum-operation accuracy do not establish locator accuracy.

distinctness_review.distance_scope: Approximate local azimuthal-equidistant separation for duplicate triage, not source positional accuracy.
distinctness_review.identity_rule: Retain the existing Clydesdale campus stable key but add one new campus-current project, not an unsupported specific phase. Historical unselected initial-phase records remain frozen. Google Stillwater, Muskogee campuses, Pryor and Meta east Tulsa are not this campus.
